introduction.situation: Philosophy asks questions about reality, knowledge, reasoning and value, and has been studied across many traditions and periods.
introduction.complication: Its subfields have been listed under many overlapping labels, so the same topic appears under several headings and kinds of question are mixed together.
introduction.question: How is everything in philosophy divided by the kind of claim at issue?
introduction.answer: Philosophy is divided by the kind of claim at issue: what there is, how we know and think, how we reason and mean, and what is valuable.
